description: Search EPA-regulated facilities by location, industry program, or compliance status across all environmental programs (CAA, CWA, RCRA, TRI, SDWA). Returns facility name, EPA Registry ID, coordinates, county FIPS code, per-program registration flags, inspection counts, penalty totals, and TRI release totals. Registry IDs returned here feed epa_get_facility and epa_get_tri_releases. Supports proximity search via latitude + longitude + radius_miles. At least one geographic filter (zip_code, state, city, or a complete latitude+longitude+radius_miles triple) is required — unscoped searches time out.

active_only.description: When true, return only active facilities

city.description: City name. Pair with state for best results.

has_violation.description: When true, return only facilities with recent significant violations

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Pair with longitude and radius_miles for proximity search.

limit.description: Maximum number of facilities to return (1–100)

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. Pair with latitude and radius_miles for proximity search.

programs.description: Restrict results to facilities registered in these environmental programs. CAA=air, CWA=water, RCRA=waste, TRI=toxic releases, SDWA=drinking water.

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles around the given latitude/longitude (max 100). Requires latitude and longitude.

name: epa_search_facilities

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_geographic_filter`: No geographic filter (zip_code, state, city, or a latitude+longitude+radius_miles triple) was provided. `incomplete_proximity`: A proximity search was started but latitude, longitude, and radius_miles were not all provided. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: EPA facility record with Registry ID, location, program flags, and compliance summary

complianceStatus.description: Overall compliance status text from ECHO

fipsCode.description: 5-digit county FIPS code — use with Census API for demographics

inspectionCount.description: Number of EPA inspections on record

rcra.description: Registered under Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA)

sdwa.description: Regulated under Safe Drinking Water Act (SDWA)

registryId.description: EPA FRS Registry ID — use as input to epa_get_facility and epa_get_tri_releases

totalPenaltiesInDollars.description: Total assessed penalties in dollars across all programs

triReleasesTransfersInLbs.description: Total TRI on/off-site releases and transfers in pounds (summary). Use epa_get_tri_releases for per-chemical breakdown.

message.description: Recovery hint when no results are found — echoes applied filters and suggests how to broaden the search. Absent when results are returned.

totalCount.description: Total facilities matched before the limit was applied

title: Search EPA Facilities
